note: research1: research-society scenes mapped onto the existing 108 patterns (patterns.json unchanged). Candidates only shorten prompts; any of the 108 ids may be used.

research_propose.label: Answering a research call with a proposal (method + budget; a small fee goes to the treasury)

QM008.play: Turn the call's topic into a question the town's data can actually answer.

QM028.play: Ask for a small budget first; promise a follow-up only if the data supports it.

QM056.play: State a result that could be proven wrong by the day statistics.

QM086.play: Cap your own budget so judges see the cost is bounded.

QM103.play: Pitch a small pilot study before any big claim.

research_decline.label: Declining a research call with a reasoned argument (recorded and shown to the council)

QM053.play: Point at what the call ignores that matters more.

QM065.play: Argue past spending is no reason to fund more of the same.

QM071.play: Show the call offers a false choice and name the third option.

QM105.play: Warn that the call rewards a number that is easy to game.

research_report.label: Writing a report: every number cites engine evidence; conclusions may be framed as you choose

QM049.play: Separate the cited facts from your inference and your recommendation.

QM055.play: Say which days or places your sample leaves out.

QM057.play: Frame the numbers in the context that favours your conclusion.

QM060.play: If an earlier claim was wrong, correct it openly.

research_verify.label: Skeptic: checking a published claim (costs world time, and a fee to the author if the claim holds)

QM013.play: Check the claim, the citation and the author separately.

QM016.play: Look for a second independent source before believing a finding.

QM054.play: Rebuild the timeline: was the window closed when it was claimed?

QM101.play: Check your own ties to the author before you start.

research_authorship.label: Authorship: claiming a report as yours is allowed, and anyone may check who filed it

QM001.play: Use someone else's finished work as your bridge in: claim it as yours.

QM059.play: Compare versions and filing times to see who wrote it first.

QM081.play: Point to the engine's filing record as preserved evidence.

QM098.play: The audit log says who filed what and when; it cannot be rewritten.
